description: (Na)₂SmCuCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a SmCuCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the SmCuCl₆ framework, Sm is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form SmCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sm-Cl bond lengths are 2.68 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sm and one Cu atom.
